Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on procurement and onboarding: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: customer verification & KYC automation for new deposit flows (pilot 1).
- Decision criteria: latency under 250ms per request, on-prem/data-residency options, SOC 2 evidence, and predictable unit economics.
- Timeline: target pilot kickoff in June, enterprise onboarding in July if PO/contract aligns.

Stakeholders (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Sarah Miller, VP Finance (we did not meet today) — Jane, can you confirm?
- Procurement lead: Kyle Roberts (procurement@venturebank.com) — primary contact for PO/invoicing
- Security/legal reviewers: internal InfoSec + Legal (you mentioned a short questionnaire)
- Implementation: product/engineering stakeholders for pilot integration

Immediate next steps
1) I’ll send our vendor onboarding checklist and a blank W-9 for your procurement team. (See attachments.)
2) David Kim (cc'd) will handle contract redlines and share a clean SOW + draft sales agreement for review.
3) Kyle — can you confirm required billing name, PO format, and any vendor registration portal?
4) Jane — please confirm the economic buyer and preferred timeline for PO issuance (target week in June?).

Attachments referenced: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, redwood_w9.pdf

If that aligns, I’ll schedule a 30-min procurement sync next week (Marissa + Kyle + David) to close on PO details.

Best,

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

- Confirmed: I’m the procurement lead for this engagement. Please send all vendor docs to procurement@venturebank.com and loop our vendor onboarding team.
- Required docs: W-9, insurance certificates, SOC 2 or equivalent attestation, consent to data processing terms, and our vendor questionnaire (I’ll attach a template shortly).
- Invoicing: We require invoices to reference a PO number and be sent to ap@venturebank.com. Billing name should match "VentureBank Vendor Accounts"? (I’ll confirm exact legal name.)
- PO timing: Depends on internal approvals, but if we get the contract and vendor forms this week, PO approval is likely within 2–3 weeks. Ideal for a June pilot is to have a PO by mid-June.

Also, Sarah Miller (Finance) will need a short one-pager on unit economics (expected monthly spend at pilot scale and estimated run rate post-pilot). Can you provide that?

I’ll upload our vendor questionnaire to you and cc procurement@venturebank.com when ready.

—Kyle
